title: Let the Right One In (bc30)
synopsis: Oskar, a bullied 12-year-old, strikes up a friendship with his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli. She is full of contradictions; her wise look, her strange smell, that fact that she is wearing such thin clothing, her neglected and skinny, yet so beautiful, appearance. Initially reserved, a sweet romance blossoms between them. But a dark, macabre secret revealing Eli’s connection to a string of bloody local murders threatens everything.

synopsis_lang.en: Oskar, a bullied 12-year-old, strikes up a friendship with his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli. She is full of contradictions; her wise look, her strange smell, that fact that she is wearing such thin clothing, her neglected and skinny, yet so beautiful, appearance. Initially reserved, a sweet romance blossoms between them. But a dark, macabre secret revealing Eli’s connection to a string of bloody local murders threatens everything.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 瑞典小鎮鄉郊，12歲男生Oskar經常被同學欺凌卻從不敢反擊，直至同樣是12歲的新鄰居Eli出現，命運從此改寫。不知是巧合還是一股神秘力量，Eli來到這小鎮後，血腥事件接連出現，但對於內向的Oskar來說，卻被這一連串的陰森故事吸引著，無論跟Eli一起有多危險，也不願離開她。 Eli因某種原因其實不宜在此地久留，但當她看到Oskar遇上人生最黑暗歲月，她還是決定回到鎮上保護她所愛的人。

cast: Kåre Hedebrant, Lina Leandersson, Per Ragnar
